These notes introduce structural equation modeling (SEM) as a framework for testing hypotheses about measurement and relationships among observed and latent variables. They cover foundational methods and extensions including causality, longitudinal models, and multilevel SEM.

The collection develops the statistical ideas alongside R examples, primarily using **lavaan**. Topics build from covariance and regression to measurement models, model assessment, multiple groups, mediation, growth curves, and multilevel models.

- [SEM notation and conceptualization](02_sem_basics/sem_notation.qmd)
- [Path analysis fundamentals](03_path_models/path_analysis_fundamental.qmd)
